scripts.text: Race Rules
scripts.translation: 比賽規則

scripts.text: Game Courses
scripts.translation: 遊戲賽道

scripts.text: Game Modes
scripts.translation: 遊戲模式

scripts.text: Prohibited Items and Skills
scripts.translation: 禁止使用的物品和技能

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The rules for all the races
are pretty simple. Just get
past all the obstacles and
try to get to the Finish Line
as quickly as you can.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
所有比賽的規則都很簡單。
通過所有障礙，儘快抵達終點就行。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Of course, some of the courses
in the races may present a few
unexpected situations, but I can't really illustrate an example...
Just know that there will
be traps lying about.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
當然，有些賽段會出現意想不到的情況，不過我也不好舉例說明...
總之，小心賽道上的陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Classes that can mount
a Peco Peco, such as Knight,
Lord Knight, Crusader and
Paladin, must get off their
Peco Pecos before entering
the Turbo Track Arena.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
騎士、騎士領主、十字軍、聖殿十字軍等能騎乘大嘴鳥的職業，必須先下來，才能進入極速賽道競技場。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Well, more accurately,
someone at the Turbo Track
entrance will ask you to get
off and will give you a ticket
so that you can rent your
Peco again free of charge.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
準確地說，入口處的工作人員會請你從大嘴鳥上下來，並給你一張票。
憑票就能免費重新租用大嘴鳥。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Now, the winner of the race
is the person who reaches the
Finish Line first. Once someone
crosses the Finish Line, the race ends and everyone is automatically transported to a Waiting Room.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
第一個到達終點的人就是冠軍。
只要有人衝過終點，比賽就會結束，所有人都會自動傳送到等候室。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Keep in mind that every
race is only 15 minutes long.
If no one can reach the Finish
Line within that time, the race
will end without a winner.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
記住，每場比賽只有15分鐘。
如果規定時間內沒人到達終點，比賽就會結束，也不會有獲勝者。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
There are no character
class or level requirements
to participate in the Turbo
Track. However, there is a
participation fee of 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
參加極速賽道沒有職業或等級限制，但需要支付1,000 Zeny的參賽費。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Races in the Turbo Track
consist of various courses:
^4d4dffLog Bridge, Cube Hills, the
Single Snail, Snake Dice, Small
Cave and the Invisible Maze.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
極速賽道設有多種賽段：^4d4dff原木橋、方塊山丘、單隻蝸牛、蛇形骰子、小洞穴和隱形迷宮。

scripts.text:

game mode. Would you like to
learn more about a certain course?
scripts.translation:

想詳細瞭解某個賽段嗎？

scripts.text: Cursed Desert and Flasher Maze
scripts.translation: 詛咒沙漠和強光陷阱迷宮

scripts.text: Single Snail and Invisible Maze
scripts.translation: 單隻蝸牛和隱形迷宮

scripts.text: Snake Dice and Small Cave
scripts.translation: 蛇形骰子和小洞穴

scripts.text: No, thanks.

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
In the Log Bridge
course, you must cross
over a single log. If you
fall off, you'll be brought
back to the beginning of
the Log Bridge.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
原木橋賽段要求你從一根原木上走過去。
要是掉下去，就會被送回原木橋的起點。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Cube Hills is a maze
consisting of piles and piles
of boxes. You can climb over
some boxes, but cannot pass
,through others. You'll have to navigate and find the best path.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
方塊山丘是由成堆的箱子組成的迷宮。
有些箱子能爬過去，有些則無法通過。
你得自己尋找最佳路線。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Cursed Desert is
a short course that is full
of surprises. If you're really
unlucky, you may find yourself
confused or even cursed!
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
詛咒沙漠雖然很短，卻處處有意外。
運氣特別差的話，你可能會陷入混亂，甚至受到詛咒！

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Flasher Maze
is full of traps that will
blind so you better be extra
careful in navigating this maze. It might be wiser to try to slow down and avoid the traps...
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
強光陷阱迷宮佈滿了致盲陷阱，穿過時一定要格外小心。
放慢速度、避開陷阱，也許更明智...

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Single Snail is
a narrow, spiral path
shaped like a snail's shell.
There aren't many obstacles,
but it will be tough to race at your top speed in this course.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
單隻蝸牛是一條像蝸牛殼一樣盤旋的狹窄小路。
障礙倒是不多，但想在這裡全速前進，可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Invisible Maze
looks like a huge, open
room, but it's actually full
of invisible walls. You'll
be given some hints, so
it's not impossible.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
隱形迷宮看起來像一間寬敞的空房間，其實佈滿了看不見的牆。
不過會給你一些提示，還是能找到出路的。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Snake Dice course
offers winding paths, much
like the body of a snake. The
factor of luck also plays a role in this course, which you'll
have to see for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
蛇形骰子的路線像蛇身一樣蜿蜒曲折。
這個賽段也得靠點運氣，具體就等你親自體驗了。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Small Cave is simply
a replica of the Payon Cave.
This part should be a breeze
if you're pretty comfortable with hunting in the Payon Cave.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
小洞穴就是仿照斐揚洞穴建的。
如果你經常在斐揚洞穴打怪，這一段應該輕而易舉。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
I see.
Okay then,
best of luck to
you in the races!
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
明白了。
那就祝你比賽好運！

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Would you like to
know anything else
about Turbo Track?
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
關於極速賽道，還想了解些什麼？

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
There are three different
game modes available for
races in the Turbo Track:
Normal, Expert and Solo.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
極速賽道有三種比賽模式：普通、專家和單人。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Unlike the other game
modes, ^4d4dffExpert Mode
allows players to PvP^000000. This mode
is ideal for races between
parties or guilds.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
與其他模式不同，^4d4dff專家模式允許玩家進行PvP^000000。
這種模式很適合隊伍或公會之間較量。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Now, the Invisible Maze is
a special course that is only
available in 16 person races
in ^4d4dffNormal^000000 and ^4D4DFFExpert^000000 modes.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
隱形迷宮是特殊賽段，只會出現在^4d4dff普通^000000和^4D4DFF專家^000000模式的16人賽中。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
If you play Solo Mode,
you can experience every
course, and the name of time
of the fastest player will be
recorded in our Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
單人模式可以體驗所有賽段。
最快玩家的名字和用時會被記入名人堂。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Now in Turbo Track, the
following items are prohibited
from use: Green Potion, Panacea
and Fly Wing. If you do try to use them, they won't work until after you leave the race track.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
極速賽道禁止使用綠色藥水、萬能藥水和蒼蠅翅膀。
即使嘗試使用也不會生效，離開賽道後才能正常使用。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The following skills cannot
be used during Turbo Track
races: Snatch, Teleport, Warp
Portal, Hiding, Cloaking, Stealth, Cure, Ice Wall, Berserk, Basilica, Sheltering Bless and Spear Dynamo.
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
極速賽道比賽中不能使用以下技能：脅持、瞬間移動、傳送之陣、隱匿、偽裝、暗影追蹤、治療術、冰刃之牆、狂暴狀態、神聖殿堂、庇護祝福和集中攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Please enjoy your
time in the Al De Baran
Turbo Track. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[極速賽道嚮導]
祝你在艾爾帕蘭極速賽道玩得開心。
謝謝~

[Turbo Track Point Manager]
Please enter the number of times you wish to convert 10 Arena Points into Turbo Track Points. The largest value you may enter
is 20. To cancel, enter '^3355FF0^000000.'

每次可以把10點競技場積分轉換成極速賽道積分，請輸入想轉換的次數。
最多隻能輸入20。
要取消，請輸入“^3355FF0^000000”。
